queries.subject: Show the durable local CLI command queue.
queries.objective: Inspect command lifecycle and reconnect to output without rerunning work.
queries.acceptance: Preserve persistent command IDs and all six server states; closing output never cancels execution. Unavailable local authority is not an empty queue.

execution.reason: Requires cli-commands, which the local SQLite projection does not provide.

queries.subject: Project shared event fields before combining run-owned records.
queries.objective: Provide the narrow retained event evidence needed for inspection and run import-coverage analysis.
queries.acceptance: The result unions retained audit, domain, tool, and issue records with their available run identity; an empty or unavailable preview cannot establish zero source activity or complete import coverage.

queries.subject: Count imported audit records per run before combining event sources.
queries.objective: Bound audit evidence for run import-coverage analysis.
queries.acceptance: Count only retained audit records with event identity by run attempt; missing evidence does not establish zero activity.

queries.subject: Count imported domain records per run before combining event sources.
queries.objective: Bound domain evidence for run import-coverage analysis.
queries.acceptance: Count only retained domain records with event identity by run attempt; missing evidence does not establish zero activity.

queries.subject: Count imported tool records per run before combining event sources.
queries.objective: Bound tool evidence for run import-coverage analysis.
queries.acceptance: Count only retained tool records with event identity by run attempt; missing evidence does not establish zero activity.

queries.subject: Count imported issue records per run before combining event sources.
queries.objective: Bound issue evidence for run import-coverage analysis.
queries.acceptance: Count only retained issue records with event identity by run attempt; missing evidence does not establish zero activity.

queries.subject: Identify each workflow run that has one or more imported run-owned records.
queries.objective: Identify run attempts with retained imported records so their presence can be compared with observed runs.
queries.acceptance: One row per organization, repository, workflow, run, and attempt contains events, the count of matching retained records; no row in an available result does not prove that no event was produced.
queries.description: Distinct workflow runs represented by imported domain, tool, audit, or issue records.

queries.subject: Identify observed runs that have one or more imported run-owned records.
queries.objective: Compare observed run attempts with retained run-owned event evidence to locate import-coverage gaps for investigation.
queries.acceptance: Keep each observed run and its run-attempt identity; imported-event-count is zero and imported is false without a matching retained event, but missing events alone do not establish an ingestion failure.
queries.description: Observed runs enriched with imported-record status.

queries.subject: Summarize observed run counts and imported runs by declared workflow.
queries.objective: Compare observed run attempts, conclusions, and imported-record coverage for each workflow.
queries.acceptance: Group by organization, repository, and workflow; report distinct run-attempt totals, successful and failed conclusion counts, and imported-run totals only from retained evidence. Missing run records cannot establish zero execution.
queries.description: Observed run and imported-run totals for each declared workflow.

queries.subject: Summarize observed run attempts and AI Credits for workflow cost comparison.
queries.objective: Count retained run attempts and recorded AI Credits without loading imported-event coverage.
queries.acceptance: Count all distinct retained run attempts, but include only positive recorded AIC in cost totals and cost denominators; zero and missing telemetry cannot skew cost averages.

queries.subject: Summarize observed AI Credit usage by declared workflow.
queries.objective: Expose retained AI Credit consumption per workflow for bounded cost review alongside observed execution.
queries.acceptance: Sum only positive recorded aic-total by organization, repository, and workflow; exclude zero and missing costs rather than treating them as free execution.
queries.description: Observed AI Credit totals for each declared workflow.

queries.subject: Summarize observed MCP calls by tool and workflow before the tool inventory is materialized.
queries.objective: Keep MCP inventory intermediates bounded without dropping calls or changing byte totals.
queries.acceptance: Count retained observation identities and sum request and response bytes per server, tool, and workflow; retain safe-output-server classification for downstream exclusion.

queries.subject: Prepare MCP tool calls for aggregation with safe-output-server calls identified for downstream exclusion.
queries.objective: Identify retained MCP call labels and safe-output-server classification for downstream tool-use investigation.
queries.acceptance: Preserve each retained call with its workflow key and tool label and mark safe-output-server calls explicitly; downstream exclusion must not be mistaken for absence of those calls or complete tool telemetry.
queries.description: Observed MCP tool calls labeled with whether they belong to the internal safe outputs server.

queries.subject: List retained GitHub issue safe outputs.
queries.objective: Inspect retained issue safe outputs and their observed closure state before deciding which items need follow-up.
queries.acceptance: Include only safe_output.result issue records, not pull requests; preserve issue and run links, timestamps, state, and status detail. Unknown or unobserved closure state must not be presented as closed.
queries.description: Issue-only projection of retained safe-output items.

queries.subject: List observed safe-output badges for the issue list Labels filter.
queries.objective: Choose retained safe-output types without scanning or filtering presented cards.
queries.acceptance: Return distinct observed badge values in ascending order; missing evidence is not an empty label inventory.

queries.subject: List observed status badges for the issue list Status filter.
queries.objective: Choose retained issue states and closing reasons without inferring resolution.
queries.acceptance: Return distinct observed status details in ascending order; Unknown remains distinct from Open and Closed.

queries.subject: Rank the ten repositories with the most retained GitHub issue safe outputs.
queries.objective: Locate repositories with the largest observed issue-safe-output volume for a bounded review of linked records.
queries.acceptance: Return at most ten repository coordinates ordered by retained issue-record count; ties or missing issue evidence must not imply a complete fleet ranking or unique issue count.
queries.description: Top repositories by retained issue safe-output count.

queries.subject: Count retained audit identities for campaign inventory source quality.
queries.objective: Retain audit provenance without reconstructing run coverage.
queries.acceptance: Count canonical audit IDs; missing evidence stays unavailable and the count is not displayed as import coverage.

queries.subject: Count retained domain identities for campaign inventory source quality.
queries.objective: Retain domain provenance without reconstructing run coverage.
queries.acceptance: Count canonical domain IDs; missing evidence stays unavailable and the count is not displayed as import coverage.

queries.subject: Count retained tool identities for campaign inventory source quality.
queries.objective: Retain tool provenance without reconstructing run coverage.
queries.acceptance: Count canonical tool IDs; missing evidence stays unavailable and the count is not displayed as import coverage.

queries.subject: Count retained issue identities for campaign inventory source quality.
queries.objective: Retain issue provenance without reconstructing run coverage.
queries.acceptance: Count canonical issue IDs; missing evidence stays unavailable and the count is not displayed as import coverage.

queries.subject: Compose retained import-source quality for campaign workflow execution totals.
queries.objective: Preserve all four import dependencies without counting unused per-run or per-workflow coverage.
queries.acceptance: Compose audit, domain, tool, and issue availability, freshness, and completeness exactly as event-runs. The retained-record count carries source quality only; it is not displayed or used as horizon-specific import coverage, executions, or outcomes. Run and AI Credit totals retain their selected horizon.

queries.subject: Summarize retained run attempts and AI Credits before campaign workflow enrichment.
queries.objective: Read run identity and recorded AI Credits together instead of enriching every run with import status.
queries.acceptance: Count distinct run-attempt identities and sum aic-total per organization, repository, and workflow; missing retained evidence is not proof of no execution or cost.

queries.subject: Attach retained import-evidence quality to compact workflow execution totals.
queries.objective: Preserve the public inventory's run and import availability composition after aggregating run evidence.
queries.acceptance: Keep runs and AI Credits unchanged; unavailable run evidence fails closed and optional import evidence degrades quality exactly as in run-import-status.
queries.description: Only source quality is consumed from import evidence. Join its compact retained-source summary after run aggregation; do not build unused run-level import coverage or change horizon-specific execution totals.

queries.subject: Project reusable campaign workflow declarations without execution evidence.
queries.objective: Share declaration display fields between structural topology and execution inventory without joining runs or import evidence.
queries.acceptance: Preserve raw organization, repository, workflow and declaration fields for joins. Select orchestrator and worker roles once, retaining inactive and unknown declarations; only list consumers select active entries. Display defaults and repository links do not establish execution, enrollment or authority.

queries.subject: Project declared campaign workflows with lean execution and configuration evidence.
queries.objective: Provide campaign totals and lists from shared declarations with separate execution and import-quality evidence.
queries.acceptance: Keep all declared orchestrators and workers, including inactive and unobserved entries; preserve inventory ordering, configuration defaults, execution totals, and import-evidence quality.
queries.description: Lean campaign inventory with execution totals that retain the public workflow inventory's evidence-quality dependencies.

queries.subject: List declared workflows with their campaign, repository, configuration, and observed execution totals.
queries.objective: Compare declared workflow configuration with retained run, import-coverage, and AI Credit evidence to select a workflow for closer inspection.
queries.acceptance: Keep one row per declared workflow with identity, role, mode, registration, links, observed totals, and ingestion indicator; zero joined totals and missing evidence must not be treated as proof of no execution or complete ingestion.
queries.description: Central campaign and repository-owned workflow inventory with observed execution totals.

queries.subject: Reduce run counts, conclusions, and positive AI Credits before repository enrichment.
queries.objective: Share one row-local run aggregate between repository execution and cost summaries.
queries.acceptance: Keep organization/repository grain, distinct run IDs, existing failure and approval counts, and positive recorded AIC. Reduce before joins; missing evidence is not zero activity or free execution.

queries.subject: Summarize observed AI Credit usage by repository.
queries.objective: Provide repository-level retained AI Credit totals for comparing observed usage with run activity.
queries.acceptance: Sum only positive recorded aic-total by organization and repository; exclude zero and missing costs rather than treating them as free execution.
queries.description: Observed AI Credit totals for each repository.

queries.subject: Installed campaign packages with retained source coordinates and update evidence.
queries.objective: Show installed/current source revisions and gate update actions on exact retained provenance.
queries.acceptance: Return every package. Set campaign-update-action-visible only for update-available rows with a non-empty source; missing provenance stays visible and non-actionable.

queries.subject: Standalone workflows with retained upstream provenance and update evidence.
queries.objective: Represent source-managed and local workflows without synthetic campaign membership.
queries.acceptance: Retain exact coordinates and revisions for source-managed rows; keep local or incomplete rows visible and non-actionable with an explicit reason.

queries.subject: Group installed and current gh-aw compiler versions and upgrade evidence by repository.
queries.objective: Identify repositories with declared Markdown workflows whose retained compiler-version evidence warrants upgrade review.
queries.acceptance: Group Markdown workflow declarations by repository coordinate and return distinct known installed/current version lists, distinct counts, upgrade-required evidence, and separate missing-installed/missing-latest flags. Never infer unavailable versions.

queries.subject: List each repository with recorded compiler versions and computed upgrade state.
queries.objective: Expose recorded compiler versions, computed upgrade state, and a concise evidence diagnostic per repository, with its GitHub home URL for inspection.
queries.acceptance: Return repository, repository-url, known version lists, upgrade-required, upgrade-state, upgrade-status-reason, and upgrade-action-visible. Show Upgrade only when known evidence establishes an outdated compiler; missing or conflicting evidence stays visible and non-actionable.

queries.subject: Expose at most one CAO package update row for the Updates navigation indicator.
queries.objective: Determine whether retained campaign metadata contains an update-available signal for the Updates indicator.
queries.acceptance: Return zero or one campaign-update-state row only when it equals update-available; an empty result means no matching retained signal, not that every campaign is current.

queries.subject: Expose at most one standalone workflow source update row for the Updates navigation indicator.
queries.objective: Determine whether retained source-managed standalone workflow metadata contains an actionable update signal for the Updates indicator.
queries.acceptance: Return zero or one workflow-update-action-visible row only when it is true; unmanaged local workflows and incomplete source evidence do not activate the indicator.

queries.subject: Expose at most one gh-aw compiler upgrade row for the Updates navigation indicator.
queries.objective: Determine whether repository compiler metadata contains an upgrade-required signal for the Updates indicator.
queries.acceptance: Return zero or one upgrade-action-visible row only when known retained evidence establishes an outdated compiler; missing evidence remains non-actionable and does not activate the indicator.

queries.subject: Project retained report-incomplete terminal outcomes as concise run diagnoses.
queries.objective: Find recorded report_incomplete terminal outcomes that can explain a specific run's incomplete reporting.
queries.acceptance: Include only runs with a recorded report_incomplete terminal outcome, preserving run-attempt identity, outcome kind, and recorded diagnosis; absence is not proof that reporting completed.
queries.description: One retained incomplete-evidence diagnosis per workflow Run when the agent explicitly reported that required evidence or access was unavailable.

queries.subject: Project workflow runs with campaign attribution and retained failure evidence.
queries.objective: Connect retained run status and failure details to declared campaign/workflow identity for run-level diagnosis.
queries.acceptance: Expose run and attempt identity, declared attribution, runtime and target repositories, status, failure and incomplete-outcome evidence, timestamps, and drill-down links; do not infer an outcome from runtime success or missing details.
queries.description: Canonical workflow runs joined to their declared campaign and workflow identity.

queries.subject: Project only the run and workflow fields required to classify current campaign runtime health.
queries.objective: Provide the retained run identity, timing, role, dispatch type, repository, and status needed to assess campaign runtime-health groups.
queries.acceptance: Project the selected fields from overview-runs without converting missing statuses or unattributed workflows into failures; unavailable run history leaves health assessment incomplete.
queries.description: A bounded runtime-health input that excludes audit outcomes and presentation-only campaign run fields.

queries.subject: Compute each campaign workflow and runtime repository's latest consecutive failure streak in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: Locate campaign workflow/runtime-repository groups whose most recent retained completed runs have consecutive runtime failures.
queries.acceptance: Group completed runs by campaign, workflow, role, dispatch type, and runtime repository; failure-count is the latest retained failure streak, not a rate or a claim about runs outside the available horizon.
queries.description: Current retained failure streaks grouped by campaign workflow and runtime repository, considering only concluded Runs so an in-flight retry cannot mask an active failure streak.

queries.subject: Count retained Runs for each workflow identity in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: Measure retained run presence by workflow identity to compare with active orchestrator declarations.
queries.acceptance: Count overview-runs by organization, repository, and workflow; a missing group indicates no retained matching run in the available horizon, not proof of no executions.
queries.description: One row per organization, repository, and workflow with retained Run counts, safe to join without row multiplication.

queries.subject: Count retained Runs for each active campaign orchestrator in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: Compare active orchestrator declarations with retained run observations to identify missing visibility.
queries.acceptance: Keep only workflows declared active with orchestrator role and expose their identity, runtime repository, and observed-run-count; a zero joined count means no retained match, not necessarily a stopped schedule.
queries.description: Active campaign orchestrators annotated with retained Run presence.

queries.subject: Mark active campaign orchestrators with no retained Runs in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: Mark active orchestrators lacking retained run evidence for bounded telemetry or schedule review.
queries.acceptance: Preserve active orchestrator identity and observed-run-count; is-unobserved marks zero retained matches and must not be interpreted as a runtime failure or evidence that dispatch was expected.
queries.description: Active orchestrators annotated with whether runtime evidence is absent.

queries.subject: Show active campaign orchestrators with no retained Runs in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: List active orchestrator declarations with no retained run observations for follow-up on evidence availability.
queries.acceptance: Return only is-unobserved candidates with their workflow and repository identity; an empty result does not certify run completeness or scheduler health.
queries.description: Active campaign orchestrators whose runtime state cannot be established from retained evidence.

queries.subject: Select workflow-dispatch runs from campaign-attributed workflow run evidence.
queries.objective: Inspect retained workflow_dispatch runs attributed to campaigns before comparing campaign dispatch activity.
queries.acceptance: Include only campaign-runs with event workflow_dispatch and preserve run, attempt, attribution, status, and time; absence does not establish that no dispatch occurred beyond retained evidence.
queries.description: Canonical workflow runs whose authoritative trigger is workflow_dispatch.

queries.subject: Project retained dispatch identity and campaign attribution before campaign counting.
queries.objective: Count dispatches without materializing run diagnoses and presentation links.
queries.acceptance: Keep workflow_dispatch runs in timestamp order with declared campaign attribution; preserve workflow and incomplete-outcome join quality and duplicate-key failure behavior.
queries.description: Lean dispatch-count input; the incomplete-outcome join preserves the full campaign run source's evidence quality and fail-closed validation.

queries.subject: Summarize observed workflow dispatches for each centrally managed campaign.
queries.objective: Compare retained workflow_dispatch run counts across attributed campaigns.
queries.acceptance: Count distinct run identifiers per campaign from dispatches; do not treat missing campaign attribution or unretained dispatches as zero actual activity.
queries.description: Observed workflow-dispatch run totals grouped by campaign.

queries.subject: Summarize observed workflow and execution totals for each centrally managed campaign.
queries.objective: Compare declared orchestrator/worker composition, rollout registration, observed runs, and AI Credit usage by campaign.
queries.acceptance: Group only orchestrator and worker workflow-inventory rows by campaign; retain workflow count, distinct roles/modes/registration and summed observed runs and AIC, without inferring successful outcomes.
queries.description: Observed workflow, rollout, run, and AI Credit totals grouped by campaign.

queries.subject: Count distinct registered target repositories reached by successful worker dispatches for each campaign.
queries.objective: Estimate observed campaign target reach from successful worker workflow_dispatch runs joined to registered repositories.
queries.acceptance: Count distinct matched target-repository values per campaign only for successful worker dispatches; this is observed reach, not verified target outcomes or complete fleet coverage.
queries.description: Campaign repository coverage derived from successful worker dispatch runs in the selected horizon.

queries.subject: Show declared campaigns before execution evidence is evaluated.
queries.objective: Expose campaign identities and navigation links while observed totals remain pending.
queries.acceptance: Preserve every declared campaign and its dashboard link without reporting missing execution totals as zero.

queries.subject: List centrally managed campaigns with their observed workflow and execution totals.
queries.objective: Compare declared campaigns with retained workflow composition, dispatches, target reach, runs, and AIC to choose an evidence-backed drill-down.
queries.acceptance: Keep declared campaigns with campaign identity and link plus joined totals; defaulted zero values mean no matching retained evidence and cannot certify no activity, complete coverage, or successful outcomes.
queries.description: Canonical campaign inventory enriched with observed workflow, rollout, run, repository coverage, and AI Credit totals.

queries.subject: Show each observed firewall domain with the number of runs and total accepted and blocked requests.
queries.objective: Identify domains with observed denied requests for a closer review of firewall evidence.
queries.acceptance: Report distinct observed runs and native accepted and blocked request totals by domain; a denied request alone does not justify allowing egress, and no row does not prove no requests occurred.
queries.description: Distinct runs and accepted and blocked request totals by firewall domain.

queries.subject: Highlight the domains with the most blocked firewall requests.
queries.objective: Prioritize up to ten observed domains by blocked request total for investigation.
queries.acceptance: Rank by observed blocked totals and inspect underlying domain/workflow evidence before deciding whether a block needs attention; the ranking is not a policy authorization or an incidence rate.
queries.description: The ten domains with the highest observed blocked request totals.

queries.subject: Show workflows that allowed or blocked requests to each observed firewall domain.
queries.objective: Locate which observed workflows contributed accepted or denied requests for a domain.
queries.acceptance: Preserve workflow scope, source link, distinct runs, and native accepted and blocked totals; investigate the run and egress context rather than assuming a denied request is a failure or grounds for wider access.
queries.description: Workflow-level accepted and blocked request totals by firewall domain.

queries.subject: Group observed MCP activity by tool and count calls and calling workflows, excluding the internal safe outputs server.
queries.objective: Expose tool-level call, workflow, and byte totals to investigate observed MCP usage.
queries.acceptance: Group only observed non-safe-output-server calls by server and tool, preserving counts and byte totals; lack of calls does not establish no access, and call volume does not establish value or permission.
queries.description: Observed MCP tool-call totals grouped by MCP server and tool, with the number of distinct calling workflows.

queries.subject: Show the ten most frequently called MCP tools.
queries.objective: Identify up to ten tools with the highest observed non-safe-output-server call counts for inspection.
queries.acceptance: Rank observed calls by tool label and inspect grouped tool evidence before drawing conclusions; do not treat popularity as effectiveness or authority to add tools.
queries.description: The ten MCP tools with the most observed calls, excluding the internal safe outputs server.

queries.subject: Prepare observed gateway steering warnings for aggregation by steering type and workflow.
queries.objective: Expose warning identity, run context, type, and timestamp for downstream steering diagnostics.
queries.acceptance: Project recorded gateway steering events with workflow and run attribution where available; a warning is not a completed budget overrun, failure, or reason to increase limits.
queries.description: Gateway steering warnings emitted when a run approaches its AI Credit budget, time limit, or another declared limit, labelled with a readable steering type.

queries.subject: Show how often each kind of steering warning occurred.
queries.objective: Identify steering warning categories to inspect in their run context.
queries.acceptance: Report observed event totals and distinct runs and workflows by type; confirm underlying warnings before interpreting frequency, and do not infer actual limit breaches.
queries.description: Observed gateway steering warnings grouped by steering type with the number of affected runs and workflows.

queries.subject: Count steering warnings for each workflow.
queries.objective: Expose workflow-level warning totals and token/time warning breakdowns for downstream review.
queries.acceptance: Count recorded events and distinct runs by workflow, retaining the declared token/time categories; other types remain in total events and no warning alone establishes a failure.
queries.description: Gateway steering warnings grouped by workflow, split into token-budget and time-limit warnings.

queries.subject: Present workflow steering totals with a link to each workflow dashboard.
queries.objective: Show observed workflow steering totals with navigation to the affected run context.
queries.acceptance: Keep workflow identity, link, events, runs, and warning breakdowns tied to their grouped evidence; use drill-through before recommending changes, not warning counts as a basis to widen budgets.
queries.description: Workflow steering totals labelled with a link to the workflow runtime page.

queries.subject: Highlight the workflows with the most steering warnings.
queries.objective: Prioritize up to ten workflows by observed warning count for investigation.
queries.acceptance: Rank recorded warning totals with workflow context, checking underlying events and telemetry coverage; a high rank neither proves overrun nor justifies a limit change.
queries.description: The ten workflows with the highest observed gateway steering warning totals.

queries.subject: Summarize run outcomes and AI Credit consumption for reusable workflow cards.
queries.objective: Compare retained run-attempt activity, recorded conclusions, and AI Credit usage per workflow card.
queries.acceptance: Group by organization, repository, and workflow; expose distinct run-attempt count, success/failure conclusion counts, and sum of recorded AIC, without treating missing run history as zero actual activity.

queries.subject: Project workflow entities for reusable workflow cards and repository drill-down.
queries.objective: Relate declared workflows to observed run and AIC totals for workflow-level drill-down.
queries.acceptance: Keep declared workflow identity, role, registration, campaign, link, and joined totals; a missing run match defaults to displayed zeros but does not establish no executions or outcomes.

queries.subject: Project canonical runs into repository-addressable run evidence.
queries.objective: Expose retained run chronology and status for a selected repository's drill-down.
queries.acceptance: Retain repository coordinate, workflow, run identity, title, event, start time, conclusion, mode, AIC, and run link; absent details or runs do not establish a healthy or idle repository.
queries.description: Workflow runs with a stable repository route key.

queries.subject: Summarize declared and disabled workflow counts by repository.
queries.objective: Compare declared and disabled workflow counts for each repository in the retained workflow inventory.
queries.acceptance: Count declared workflows and workflow-active=false entries by organization and repository; missing declarations must not be interpreted as a complete zero-workflow inventory.
queries.description: Declared and disabled workflow totals for each repository.

queries.subject: Summarize published outcome report counts by repository.
queries.objective: Show retained outcome-report volume per repository for comparison with observed execution.
queries.acceptance: Count retained outcome rows by organization and repository; a missing aggregate does not prove no reports were published or that reported outcomes succeeded.
queries.description: Published report totals for each repository.

queries.subject: Project the run-attempt identities needed to match imported evidence.
queries.objective: Keep import-coverage joins narrow without carrying run details, links, or costs.
queries.acceptance: Preserve each selected run attempt and its organization, repository, workflow, run, and attempt keys. Do not deduplicate attempts or change selected-horizon semantics.

queries.subject: Count selected run attempts with matching retained imported records.
queries.objective: Join compact run identities to already reduced event evidence, then reduce import coverage by repository.
queries.acceptance: Match all five run-attempt keys and count each selected run row once when events are positive. Preserve optional-evidence quality and horizon filters; records for unselected runs do not establish coverage.

queries.subject: Summarize distinct runs, failures, and approval-required runs by repository.
queries.objective: Join already reduced run statistics and import coverage at repository grain.
queries.acceptance: Group by organization and repository; preserve distinct run IDs, configured failure/action-required conclusion counts, and imported-run sums. Missing enrichment or run history must not be treated as complete coverage.
queries.description: Distinct run and conclusion totals for each repository.

queries.subject: List repository identities before execution metrics are computed.
queries.objective: Show retained repository identities and drill links while activity metrics are pending.
queries.acceptance: List repositories by organization with repository drill links; this preview does not establish activity totals or outcomes.
queries.description: Fast repository inventory with drill links; activity fields remain pending.

queries.subject: Join each repository with its workflow, report, and run totals.
queries.objective: Attach retained workflow, report, and run aggregates to each repository for bounded inventory review.
queries.acceptance: Preserve each repository and the available joined aggregates by organization and repository; unmatched metrics remain missing evidence, not confirmed zero activity or evaluated outcomes.
queries.description: Repository inventory joined with workflow, report, evaluation, and run totals.

queries.subject: Show repository-level execution health, outcome activity, and AI Credit usage in an actionable inventory.
queries.objective: Prioritize repository drill-down using declared workflows, observed runs, reports, failures, import coverage, and AIC.
queries.acceptance: Return repository identity and link with retained counts, ingestion indicator, failure summary, AIC, and computed status; statuses describe retained evidence only, and an empty or unavailable preview cannot verify health, outcomes, or zero activity.
queries.description: Repository-local execution health and attributed outcome totals.

queries.subject: Select repository run counts by whole UTC start-day buckets.
queries.objective: Keep count selection independent of retained Run detail.
queries.acceptance: Use UTC midnight and request bounds, matching the Runs daily chart; do not fabricate sub-day totals or missing days.

queries.subject: Count observed logical Runs by repository from persistent daily buckets.
queries.objective: Supply the run-volume chart without computing activity health, ingestion coverage, or workflow costs.
queries.acceptance: Sum daily totals, not attempts or retained detail. Select whole UTC start-day buckets by midnight and preserve partial or unavailable coverage.

queries.subject: Registered repositories and observed daily logical Run counts.
queries.objective: Compare repository execution volume and choose repositories for drill-down.
queries.acceptance: Keep top 100 identities and drill links with stable count and repository ordering. Zero means no admitted dated Runs in selected UTC buckets, not inactivity. Preserve partial coverage; unavailable daily evidence must not produce zeros. Table keeps full inventory.

queries.subject: Project the selected workflow's identity and registration for its route shell.
queries.objective: Identify the workflow and its recorded campaign registration before inspecting route-specific evidence.
queries.acceptance: Preserve organization, repository, workflow identity, recorded role, activation, campaign, rollout mode, and source link; absent registration is not inferred from runs, and displayed activation does not grant execution authority.

queries.subject: Sum daily runtime conclusion counts for the selected workflow.
queries.objective: Inspect observed dated runs independently of retained detail.
queries.acceptance: Sum by organization/repository/workflow without adding detail; successful, failed, approval, pending, and other sum to total. Dates use UTC run start; undated evidence is incomplete and missing projection is unavailable. Pending is last-observed state, success is not a verified outcome, and sub-day filters are unsupported.

queries.subject: Sum retained AI Credits and count telemetry rows for the selected workflow without transferring runs.
queries.objective: Inspect a workflow's observed AI Credit consumption together with the amount of retained usage telemetry.
queries.acceptance: AI Credits sum the retained aic values within each organization, repository, and workflow, and telemetry-count counts its usage records; absent telemetry does not establish zero cost or complete run coverage.

queries.subject: Project the selected safe-output record for the outcome route and its sections.
queries.objective: Inspect a retained safe output's recorded disposition and follow its durable evidence links.
queries.acceptance: Preserve safe-output and run identity, title, category, disposition, summary, timestamps, rollout mode, workflow context, and retained links; missing fields stay unknown and a recorded disposition is not independently verified operational impact.

queries.subject: Project run entities for reusable run cards and workflow drill-down.
queries.objective: Expose retained run-attempt identity, execution timing, conclusion, and link for a bounded workflow-run inspection.
queries.acceptance: Keep organization, repository, workflow, run and attempt with status, conclusion, event, branch, duration, timestamps, and run link; missing timing or conclusion remains unknown rather than inferred success.

queries.subject: Project canonical runs into route-addressable workflow run evidence.
queries.objective: Trace retained runs and recorded failure evidence for a selected workflow route.
queries.acceptance: Preserve workflow route, run identity, start/end, status, conclusion, failure fields, mode, engine/model metadata, and run link; missing failure details do not prove success or rule out incomplete import.
queries.description: Workflow runs with a stable repository and workflow route key.

queries.subject: Show recent failure counts and their change for each workflow.
queries.objective: Spot a change in observed workflow failure activity without treating unknown conclusions as failures.
queries.acceptance: Each observed failure counts once within its own workflow; the first change is undefined and the seven-observation window is not a seven-day calendar interval.

queries.subject: Project retained outcomes into route-addressable workflow reports.
queries.objective: Review retained workflow outcome reports separately from execution status before interpreting operational results.
queries.acceptance: Keep route, safe output, report title and summary, recorded status, category, observation time, metadata, and external link; missing reports or status do not imply success or no work.
queries.description: Workflow outcome reports with stable route keys and disposition fields.

queries.subject: Original native primary and diagnostic observations from reviewed batch evaluators.
queries.objective: Keep periods, native units, evaluator identity and missingness inspectable without inventing delivery events.
queries.acceptance: Null is unavailable, not zero. Interval measurements are not snapshots or cumulative accepted contributions.

queries.subject: Latest assessment of each workflow measure, including unavailable assessments.
queries.objective: Do not let an older numeric value hide a newer incomplete period.
queries.acceptance: Choose latest cutoff and assessment before considering value or coverage; preserve evaluator digest.

queries.subject: Latest native primary measurements, separately from event-ledger reports.
queries.objective: Expose ordinary reviewed batch results on the same Value surface.
queries.acceptance: Do not infer healthy outcomes, accepted implementations or complete coverage from a non-null value.

queries.subject: Published original evidence for frozen workflow value contracts.
queries.objective: Keep report identity, target repository, workflow and capture together.
queries.acceptance: Read canonical evidence only. No GitHub acquisition, HTML loading or fabricated evidence on navigation.

queries.subject: One retained contract per repository, workflow and versioned native measure.
queries.objective: Compute each report independently before selecting current workflow results.
queries.acceptance: Preserve separate versions and exact report identity. Latest-version selection belongs to the workflow result query.

queries.subject: Accepted complete native batch assessments, separately from collection decisions.
queries.objective: Expose actual retained capture clocks without advancing them on failure or partial data.
queries.acceptance: Only mature complete non-null primary assessments establish an accepted capture; zero remains valid.

queries.subject: Original capture clocks from accepted rich evidence packets.
queries.objective: Align capture metadata without merging measured populations.
queries.acceptance: This union is capture metadata only, never combined metric totals.

queries.subject: Actual captures across the retained measures of each workflow.
queries.objective: Expose the last accepted capture independently of collection decisions.
queries.acceptance: Select by original capture time. A deferred or failed check cannot advance evidence clocks.

queries.subject: One last accepted capture per workflow, not a freshness claim.
queries.objective: Join capture and cutoff without multiplying collection registrations.
queries.acceptance: Missing packets remain unavailable, never zero or an inferred successful collection.

queries.subject: Reviewed registration and authoritative collection decisions, with independently retained evidence.
queries.objective: Explain disabled, unconfigured, deferred, failed and not-yet-captured workflows.
queries.acceptance: Use published collector facts, not missing result cards. Preserve decision, attempt, capture and cutoff as distinct clocks.

queries.subject: Reviewed Value registrations, including explicit disables and registrations with no report.
queries.objective: Make collection health visible before the first accepted packet.
queries.acceptance: Registration is independent of measured outcomes. No enrollment or acquisition follows from navigation.

queries.subject: Independent repository-state observations and exact item drill-downs.
queries.objective: Keep everyone's changes separate from workflow-linked delivery.
queries.acceptance: Retain observed native values, dates and immutable references. Do not invent intermediate observations.

queries.subject: First independently observed repository state.
queries.objective: Name the actual first-snapshot reference rather than an invented baseline.
queries.acceptance: Strictly use retained snapshot time. A post-adoption snapshot is not a pre-adoption baseline.

queries.subject: First retained snapshot per report.
queries.objective: Provide the explicit reference value and date.
queries.acceptance: No retained reference means no comparison.

queries.subject: Latest independently observed repository state.
queries.objective: Show the actual last measurement rather than an extrapolation.
queries.acceptance: Preserve the latest retained snapshot even if unchanged.

queries.subject: Last retained snapshot per report.
queries.objective: Provide the current native observation.
queries.acceptance: One snapshot establishes state, not movement.

queries.subject: Retained safe outputs and applied creation receipts.
queries.objective: Describe output activity without treating it as accepted value.
queries.acceptance: Count distinct validated output facts. Tracking corroboration is not an applied receipt.

queries.subject: Distinct accepted implementations and their measured native effects.
queries.objective: Count each accepted implementation once, including zero and negative effects.
queries.acceptance: Validated implementation identities are unique; many-to-many output edges must not multiply value. Complete coverage is checked separately.

queries.subject: Explicit complete evidence durations in the report and adjacent 28-day delivery periods.
queries.objective: Distinguish known zero from gaps or incomplete evidence.
queries.acceptance: The producer validates non-overlapping bounded coverage. Count only complete intervals, clipped to each exact half-open period.

queries.subject: Evidence-qualified output and accepted-contribution totals.
queries.objective: Keep populations and native units separate without an implied conversion rate.
queries.acceptance: Absent output context is unknown. Missing coverage withholds complete totals and recent zero, retaining labelled known subtotals.

queries.subject: Shared native card and report comparison against the first retained snapshot.
queries.objective: Show signed repository-wide movement, the goal direction and the exact comparison dates.
queries.acceptance: This first/last snapshot comparison is not the adjacent-period alert policy, a pre-adoption baseline or causal workflow credit. One snapshot is not zero change.

queries.subject: Version ordering after independently computing each report.
queries.objective: Keep exact report queries partition-local without changing latest-version selection.
queries.acceptance: Rank cutoffs then captures within each workflow and measure. Explicit report links do not need other report facts.

queries.subject: Current published report results per native measure.
queries.objective: Expose the latest coherent packet on the workflow Value tab.
queries.acceptance: Never replace missing facts with an older measured version. Explicit report links retain their own version.

queries.subject: Most recent current report across the measures of each workflow.
queries.objective: Give each workflow and repository one headline result; other measures stay on the workflow page.
queries.acceptance: Select by cutoff then capture. Never replace a missing result with an older or zero value.

queries.subject: One headline result per workflow and repository.
queries.objective: Join cleanly to collection health without multiplying rows.
queries.acceptance: Exactly one row per workflow route.

queries.subject: Workflows with a retained headline result, with any published collection state.
queries.objective: Show a report even when no collection fact was published for its workflow.
queries.acceptance: A missing collection fact stays unknown, never an inferred registration.

queries.subject: Registered workflows marked with whether a headline result exists.
queries.objective: Separate registration from retained outcomes before selecting unreported workflows.
queries.acceptance: Join on workflow route only; one row per registration.

queries.subject: Registered workflows that have no retained headline result.
queries.objective: Keep collection health visible before the first accepted packet.
queries.acceptance: No result is not zero value or a healthy outcome.

queries.subject: One row per workflow and repository: collection health plus its headline result trend.
queries.objective: Show the first-to-last trend and collection state in a single card.
queries.acceptance: Missing reports remain unavailable, never zero. Registration and outcome stay independent facts.

queries.subject: Immutable extracted workflow intent sources.
queries.objective: Let readers inspect the original goal and requirements.
queries.acceptance: Only retained HTTPS evidence is linked; workflow text remains untrusted.

queries.subject: Original full acceptance requirements.
queries.objective: Distinguish the measured structural facet from all workflow safeguards.
queries.acceptance: Requirements are source text, not proof they passed.

queries.subject: Retained safe-output lifecycle facts.
queries.objective: Show receipts, current-at-cutoff state and originating evidence.
queries.acceptance: A closed output is not automatically an accepted implementation; absence of a link is unknown.

queries.subject: Retained producer and applied safe-output evidence.
queries.objective: Let readers distinguish receipt-confirmed creation from corroborated tracking.
queries.acceptance: Tracking identities locate outputs but do not establish accepted value. Keep unavailable producer evidence explicit.

queries.subject: Accepted implementations and native before/after effects.
queries.objective: Expose delivery time and immutable acceptance evidence.
queries.acceptance: Do not equate acceptance with full quality verification or omit negative effects.

queries.subject: Explicit output-to-implementation edges.
queries.objective: Make the trail from a proposal to an accepted measured change inspectable.
queries.acceptance: Use retained dated edges only. Many-to-many links do not duplicate headline counts or values.

queries.subject: Measured implementation files and retained lineage sources.
queries.objective: Link to exact Git facts rather than only a repository tree.
queries.acceptance: No URL is reconstructed from an unrelated revision. Preserve before, after and replacement file evidence.

queries.subject: Explicit independent verification checks.
queries.objective: Keep unverified behavior, tests and other safeguards visible.
queries.acceptance: Missing or not-verified is not a passing check.

queries.subject: Retained evidence and attribution limitations.
queries.objective: Qualify claims without inventing completeness.
queries.acceptance: Treat source limitations as untrusted text and never suppress them.

queries.subject: Actual counted items at an independent immutable snapshot.
queries.objective: Open exact per-item evidence from the plotted observation.
queries.acceptance: Only retained items are shown. Missing item evidence must not look like an empty measured population.

queries.subject: Aggregate high- and medium-severity audit events with the same severity and summary by workflow.
queries.objective: Select recurring high- or medium-severity audit summaries for run-level investigation.
queries.acceptance: Each bucket's event count is traceable to retained audit or tool observations with the same campaign, severity, workflow, and summary; missing workflow attribution stays unknown, and a count alone does not verify impact.
queries.description: High- and medium-severity audit event counts grouped by severity, workflow, and shared summary.

queries.subject: List campaign-owned orchestrator and worker workflows with database-backed execution totals.
queries.objective: Choose an active campaign workflow whose observed execution warrants inspection.
queries.acceptance: Listed workflows match active declared orchestrator or worker inventory entries; runs and AI Credits agree with the selected-horizon inventory, and absence is not evidence of disabled authority or no executions. Rollout mode is context, not permission to change policy.
queries.description: Campaign workflows projected from lean canonical inventory, with shared declaration names and active-only workflow drill-down links.

queries.subject: List active declared campaign workflows and their owning repositories without execution evidence.
queries.objective: Inspect campaign repository topology without computing unused run totals or import coverage.
queries.acceptance: Preserve active orchestrator and worker identities, display names, rollout context, links, and ordering. Declaration counts are not target enrollment, dispatch coverage, or execution totals. Empty inventory and unavailable workflow evidence remain distinct.
queries.description: Declaration-only repository topology. Run totals and import-evidence quality belong to execution views, not this inventory.

queries.subject: Present declared campaign repository topology in workflow display order.
queries.objective: Filter and search projected repository coordinates and workflow names without time-filtering structural declarations.
queries.acceptance: Preserve the campaign workflow list's stable ordering and declaration-only evidence quality; runtime horizons must not remove declared workflows.

queries.subject: Project retained outcomes into campaign-addressable report evidence.
queries.objective: Identify a campaign report whose durable outcome record needs follow-up.
queries.acceptance: Each report's campaign, title, source link, observation time, and disposition match its retained outcome; missing status is labeled unknown rather than accepted or resolved, and report production is not verified impact.
queries.description: Campaign outcome reports with database-backed disposition fields.

queries.subject: Project issue outcomes created by campaign worker workflows.
queries.objective: Choose a campaign worker issue whose current recorded disposition needs review.
queries.acceptance: Include only issues whose producing run joins declared worker inventory on organization, repository, and workflow, even when the issue lands elsewhere. Preserve campaign and role across Activity imports. Retain run and status evidence; missing closure details stay unknown and closure is not proof of resolution.
queries.description: Campaign-addressable issue outcomes restricted to declared worker workflows.

queries.subject: Count the retained worker issues available for each campaign Reports tab.
queries.objective: Decide whether a campaign has retained worker issue reports to inspect.
queries.acceptance: For each returned campaign, items equals the number of rows in campaign-worker-issues for that campaign in the same horizon; missing campaigns are not treated as zero issues or verified resolution.
queries.description: One campaign row with the number of retained issue outcomes produced by campaign workers.

queries.subject: Resolve one repository link for each campaign README from its declared orchestrator workflow.
queries.objective: Locate the declared orchestrator repository to contextualize a campaign README.
queries.acceptance: Each returned campaign and repository link traces to a declared orchestrator workflow; missing or multiple declarations are reported as uncertain rather than inventing a canonical repository.

queries.subject: Present retained campaign README content with its repository-relative link context.
queries.objective: Open the campaign's retained README in its declared repository context before relying on its guidance.
queries.acceptance: The README text and path match the campaign record and any repository link resolves through a declared orchestrator; absent content or repository linkage remains unavailable, not inferred.

queries.subject: Provide the registered campaigns whose repository memory can be browsed together.
queries.objective: Choose a registered campaign for repository-memory inspection.
queries.acceptance: Each campaign identity and display name matches the retained campaign registry in the selected scope; listing a campaign does not establish that memory observations exist or are complete.
queries.description: Registered campaigns ordered for the all-campaign repository-memory browser.

queries.subject: Establish a selected-horizon campaign baseline from concluded run attempts while keeping reliability, unverified production, and efficiency as separate facts.
queries.objective: Select campaigns whose retained run reliability, output production, or AI Credit efficiency merits closer examination.
queries.acceptance: Concluded and successful attempts, outputs, and mean AI Credits reconcile to filtered retained runs; absent denominators or costs stay unknown. Produced outputs are unverified, not operational value.
queries.description: Canonical campaign run attempts aggregated into bounded selected-horizon baseline totals without treating runtime success or produced outputs as operational value.

queries.subject: Turn each campaign's selected-horizon baseline totals into deterministic reliability and production signals with an explicit successful-run efficiency fact.
queries.objective: Decide which campaign baseline signal needs run- or output-level verification next.
queries.acceptance: Success-rate and signal labels follow the retained totals and their explicit denominators; no concluded attempts or output evidence is distinguished from zero verified impact, and AI Credits per successful run remain a separate cost fact rather than a value score.
queries.description: A bounded, explainable baseline that distinguishes runtime reliability, unverified output production, and AI Credit efficiency.

queries.subject: List retained failed runs for campaign problem investigation.
queries.objective: Choose a recent failed campaign run to investigate with its diagnostic evidence.
queries.acceptance: Each row corresponds to a retained campaign run with a declared failure, startup-failure, stale, or timed-out status; campaign-problem-run-evidence orders matching rows newest first. Absence is not proof of healthy execution or complete ingestion.
queries.description: Private failed-run input with retained diagnostic metadata; the evidence consumer orders only runs matching current runtime problems.

queries.subject: Select current failing runtime partitions without presentation ordering.
queries.objective: Retain the exact current-failure eligibility needed by the problem evidence join.
queries.acceptance: A latest failure streak is a nonnegative integer, so failure-count at least one is equivalent to has-current-failure; missing or incomplete runtime evidence remains unknown.
queries.description: Private unsorted failure partitions for problem evidence; ordering is supplied by the retained failed runs.

queries.subject: Project current runtime problem keys and diagnoses for the failed-run evidence join.
queries.objective: Avoid sorting and retaining unused runtime problem presentation fields.
queries.acceptance: Retain both current failures and unobserved orchestrators, including their metadata and duplicate-key failure semantics; this projection does not establish health or root cause.
queries.description: Private compact equivalent of campaign-runtime-problems for equality enrichment, not presentation.

queries.subject: Attach the current campaign runtime problem summary to each retained failed Run for that partition.
queries.objective: Inspect the failure count and problem kind alongside a failed run without inferring its root cause.
queries.acceptance: Each returned row joins a retained failed run to a runtime problem on campaign, workflow, and runtime repository; the inner join drops unmatched runs, so compare with campaign-problem-runs before interpreting absence as no problem.
queries.description: Failed campaign runs annotated with the failure-count and problem-kind of their active runtime problem, one row per retained failed Run.

queries.subject: Identify the most recent retained failed Run for each campaign workflow target repository.
queries.objective: Select the latest retained failed run identity for each campaign workflow and target partition.
queries.acceptance: For every returned campaign, workflow, runtime repository, and target repository, latest-target-run agrees with the maximum retained failed run identity in that partition; a missing partition is not a healthy target.
queries.description: One row per campaign workflow and target repository with its most recent retained failed Run identity.

queries.subject: Cluster retained failed Run evidence by workflow, runtime repository, target repository, and error signature so repeated identical failures for one target collapse into one diagnosable group.
queries.objective: Rank repeated target-specific error signatures for investigation without merging unrelated failures.
queries.acceptance: Occurrence-count and latest-run match retained failed runs grouped by campaign, workflow, repositories, problem kind, and signature; unknown signatures may group together. Counts do not prove a root cause.
queries.description: One row per distinct target repository and error signature within a campaign runtime problem partition, with an occurrence count and the most recent matching Run identity for follow-up.

queries.subject: Keep only the newest error signature for each campaign workflow target repository.
queries.objective: Focus investigation on the signature associated with the latest retained failed run per target.
queries.acceptance: Each returned group joins campaign-problem-latest-target-runs on campaign, workflow, runtime repository, and latest run ID; target repository is not a join key, so verify target identity against underlying runs before claiming one current signature per target.
queries.description: Current target-specific error groups whose representative Run is the target repository's most recent retained failed Run.

queries.subject: Attach the most recent representative Run evidence to each distinct campaign runtime problem error signature.
queries.objective: Open the representative failed run and target for each current campaign problem group.
queries.acceptance: Check joined run-link, run ID, campaign, workflow, and runtime repository; verify target against run evidence (not a join key). Unobserved orchestrators need inventory review. Missing evidence remains unknown; rollout mode does not authorize policy changes.
queries.description: Current campaign runtime problems represented by the newest error signature for each target repository, with its effective rollout mode, an occurrence count, the most recent matching failed Run, and a repair prompt.

queries.subject: Count the current runtime problem items available for each campaign Problems tab.
queries.objective: Determine whether the campaign has current retained failure groups requiring review.
queries.acceptance: For every returned campaign, items equals the number of campaign-problem-items rows in the same horizon; a missing count does not establish zero failures or healthy execution.
queries.description: One campaign row with the number of current runtime problem groups.

queries.subject: Project successful concluded attempts from the selected-horizon campaign baseline.
queries.objective: Show the successful share of concluded runs without implying verified impact.
queries.acceptance: Counts reconcile to campaign-performance-baseline-totals; missing campaigns do not imply zero runs.

queries.subject: Project non-successful concluded attempts from the selected-horizon campaign baseline.
queries.objective: Show the remaining concluded runs for reliability review.
queries.acceptance: Runs equal concluded-runs minus successful-runs; the category includes every other concluded status, not just failures.

queries.subject: Compare successful and other concluded attempts in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: Spot campaign run reliability that needs inspection.
queries.acceptance: Successful and other counts sum to concluded attempts; neither runtime result nor output production establishes operational value.

queries.subject: Describe the rendered audit-summary chart using the shared campaign Insights plot contract.
queries.objective: Find campaigns with retained high- or medium-severity audit summaries worth reviewing.
queries.acceptance: Each campaign's bucket count equals its retained audit-event-summary-buckets rows; the count describes displayed groups, not distinct incidents or confirmed harm, and missing buckets are not proof of safety.
queries.description: One plot-inventory row per campaign when its high- and medium-severity audit summary chart has data.

queries.subject: Inventory every plot rendered on each campaign Insights page through one reusable plot contract.
queries.objective: Choose an available campaign Insights plot to inspect its underlying evidence.
queries.acceptance: Each plot entry is supplied by the audit summary plot inventory for the same campaign; experimental operational-value evidence is excluded, no plot count is treated as outcome quality, and unavailable evidence is not synthesized into a plot.
queries.description: One campaign row per rendered Insights plot, independent of the plot's data source or renderer.

queries.subject: Count the plots declared by the shared campaign Insights plot inventory.
queries.objective: Determine whether a campaign has evidence-backed Insights plots to inspect.
queries.acceptance: For every returned campaign, items equals its rows in campaign-insight-plot-inventory for the same horizon; absent rows do not establish absent value, and plot counts do not measure impact.
queries.description: One campaign row with the number of rendered Insights plots, independent of plot type.

queries.subject: Order retained run attempts within each workflow by their observed start time.
queries.objective: Identify each workflow's latest execution without importing event coverage or outcome totals.
queries.acceptance: The first chronological attempt in each workflow partition has no preceding run delta; break timestamp ties by run ID and attempt, and use creation time for queued runs.

queries.subject: Project the latest retained run attempt for each workflow.
queries.objective: Expose each workflow's latest observed execution state without implying aggregate outcomes.
queries.acceptance: Select only the first chronologically ordered attempt per workflow; preserve queued and in-progress states instead of treating unknown conclusions as failures.

queries.subject: Show workflow declarations while latest-run evidence is still loading.
queries.objective: Make workflow identities and drill links available before retained runs are evaluated.
queries.acceptance: Preserve every declared workflow and its drill link; leave latest-run fields absent until the complete projection arrives.

queries.subject: List declared workflows in latest observed run order.
queries.objective: Open a dedicated workflow page from a lightweight inventory with its latest execution status.
queries.acceptance: Preserve textual run identities and keep unobserved workflows last with an explicit missing-run state; use only workflow declarations and retained runs, not event coverage or aggregate success/failure counters.

queries.subject: Select whole UTC start-day buckets against the requested time bounds.
queries.objective: Expose UTC bucket boundaries for declarative daily time selection.
queries.acceptance: Compute bounds from observed execution-start days only; missing request bounds remain unset and no sub-day totals or missing days are fabricated.

queries.subject: Sum observed daily run health across the selected scope.
queries.objective: Keep daily activity counts independent of detail retention.
queries.acceptance: Sum only daily counts, never retained Runs. UTC start-day buckets are selected by midnight; sub-day totals are unsupported. Missing or undated evidence remains unavailable or partial.

queries.subject: Observed daily successful run counts.
queries.objective: Expose the successful class for the daily runtime-health chart.
queries.acceptance: Project successful counts from scoped daily totals without re-reading detail; runtime success does not imply accepted outcomes.

queries.subject: Observed daily failed run counts.
queries.objective: Expose the failed class for the daily runtime-health chart.
queries.acceptance: Project failed counts from scoped daily totals, preserving zero counts and aggregate coverage without deriving incidents.

queries.subject: Observed daily approval-required run counts.
queries.objective: Expose approval-required observations in the daily runtime-health chart.
queries.acceptance: Project approval counts from scoped daily totals without treating approval-required observations as successes or failures.

queries.subject: Observed daily pending run counts.
queries.objective: Expose last-observed pending state in the daily runtime-health chart.
queries.acceptance: Project pending counts from scoped daily totals; counts describe last-observed evidence, not a live execution census.

queries.subject: Observed daily unclassified terminal or missing-status run counts.
queries.objective: Expose the remaining runtime-health class without implying success.
queries.acceptance: Project other counts from scoped daily totals; preserve zeros and coverage without interpreting skipped, cancelled, or unknown evidence as success.

queries.subject: Daily observed runtime health classes for the Runs chart.
queries.objective: Investigate daily activity independently of retained run detail.
queries.acceptance: Classes sum to observed dated Runs, not attempts or verified outcomes. Pending is last-observed state; Other is not success. Select whole UTC start-day buckets by midnight, not sub-day totals. Preserve partial or unavailable coverage.

queries.subject: Project all run-owned records for reusable cards and run drill-down.
queries.objective: Expose run-owned event identity, status, provenance, timestamp, and available navigation links for inspection.
queries.acceptance: Projected event fields and fallback URL trace to the source record; a missing link or event is not proof of no output, and event status alone does not verify downstream impact.

queries.subject: Show observed workflow runs in a table with execution, repository, workflow, engine, model, and navigation details.
queries.objective: Locate observed runs whose recorded status or conclusion needs closer inspection.
queries.acceptance: Show recorded run identity, status, conclusion, scope, execution metadata, and source links in newest-first order; absent runs require a freshness and coverage check, and a successful run is not proof of accepted outcomes.
queries.description: Observed workflow runs ordered from newest to oldest.

queries.subject: List declared workflows with recorded positive AI Credit costs and their average cost per run.
queries.objective: Identify workflows with observed run AIC averages worth investigating alongside run evidence.
queries.acceptance: Include only declared workflows with at least one run attempt reporting positive AIC; exclude zero and missing telemetry from the average and ranking, without interpreting missing telemetry as free execution.
queries.description: Workflow AI Credit averages limited to run attempts with recorded positive AIC.

queries.subject: Expose the current collection state for the global ingestion indicator.
queries.objective: Distinguish reported ingestion failure or recovery from the age of retained workflow evidence.
queries.acceptance: Use the authorized server collection-health classification, not cumulative failures or browser refresh time. Missing or unauthorized health remains unknown and static dashboards do not request this source.

queries.subject: Find the newest workflow activity timestamp in retained canonical data.

queries.subject: Read the activity date encoded in each retained transaction's shard filename.

queries.subject: Show retained ingestion transactions at the activity date encoded in their shard filename.
