queries.acceptance: Preserve every dated transaction, including coincident dates, all kinds, and zero counts, without grouping, limits, or page filters. Omit missing or invalid shard dates; never substitute import time. Missing counts use labeled zero-position placeholders, not measured zeroes.

queries.subject: Inspect admitted daily logical Run counts independently of retained detail and shard receipts.
queries.objective: Make the daily run-count projection visible as an ingestion diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Sum daily buckets by observed UTC execution-start day across repositories and workflows, without page filters, detail fallback, fabricated days or zero populations. Preserve aggregate coverage and partial or unavailable evidence; counts do not prove upstream completeness.

queries.subject: Count retained campaigns rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained campaigns row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result campaigns and count campaign rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected campaign coverage.

queries.subject: Count retained repositories rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained repositories row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result repositories and count repository rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected repository coverage.

queries.subject: Count retained workflows rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained workflows row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result workflows and count workflow rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected workflow coverage.

queries.subject: Count retained workflow runs rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained workflow runs row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result workflow runs and count run rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected execution volume.

queries.subject: Count retained network domains rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained network domains row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result network domains and count domain event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no network activity.

queries.subject: Count retained tool events rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained tool events row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result tool events and count tool event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no tool use.

queries.subject: Count retained audit events rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained audit events row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result audit events and count audit event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no audit findings.

queries.subject: Count retained issue events rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained issue events row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result issue events and count issue event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no issues exist.

queries.subject: Count retained operational values rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained operational values row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result operational values and count operational-value rows in the current database; absence or zero does not imply zero value or an evaluated outcome.

queries.subject: Count retained ingestion transactions rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained ingestion transactions row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result ingestion transactions and count transaction IDs in the current database; absence or zero does not establish whether upstream ingestion ran.

queries.subject: Count retained canonical dashboard database rows by table.
queries.objective: Compare the retained table row counts to identify tables needing further ingestion or coverage investigation.
queries.acceptance: Union the named table-count projections and report their table labels and counts; check source availability, retention, and separate transaction evidence before interpreting an empty or small table as an ingestion defect.

queries.subject: Prepare retained ingestion transactions for card presentation.
queries.objective: Expose transaction identity, kind, timestamp, committed-record count, and payload hash for ingestion traceability.
queries.acceptance: Projected fields match retained transactions without implying successful upstream coverage from a committed count or hash alone; missing transactions require a freshness and availability check.

queries.subject: Describe agent and model combinations in the seven-day statistical run sample.
queries.objective: Find sampled combinations to investigate without scanning the full retained run history.
queries.acceptance: Count unweighted selected Runs after frame selection. Keep statistical-frame-id in grouped rows and frame metadata on empty results. Zero-allocation strata are not population zeros. Preserve unknown identifiers; failure reserves can alter composition. Never mix sample counts with exact usage or infer population shares.
queries.description: Unweighted composition of the seven-day statistical sample; not a population estimate. Failure outcomes may be oversampled.

queries.subject: Summarize run-level AIC and token usage by agent and model identifiers without treating unavailable telemetry as zero.
queries.objective: Locate agent and model combinations whose observed per-run AIC or token usage merits checking against individual runs.
queries.acceptance: Report run counts and native minimum, mean, and maximum values only for reported metrics; inspect underlying runs for per-metric telemetry coverage and context before comparing combinations, and infer neither efficiency nor outcome value from usage alone.
queries.description: Observed workflow runs grouped by agent ID and model ID. AIC statistics use only positive-AIC runs; token statistics use runs that reported each token metric.

queries.subject: Select observed skill invocations for skill usage analytics.
queries.objective: Expose skill event identity, scope, invocation counts, and failed counts for downstream usage analysis.
queries.acceptance: Keep each observed event and its repository/workflow attribution with native counts; missing records or failed counts alone do not establish whether a skill was useful or available.

queries.subject: Rank skills by their observed invocation count.
queries.objective: Identify skills with the highest observed invocation totals for follow-up inspection.
queries.acceptance: Sum observed invocation counts by skill and retain the rank as a usage description; do not equate popularity with effectiveness or infer unobserved invocations.

queries.subject: Rank workflows by their observed skill invocation count.
queries.objective: Produce repository-scoped workflow invocation totals for downstream skill-usage comparison.
queries.acceptance: Sum observed invocation counts by organization, repository, and workflow; totals describe recorded usage only, not success or expected adoption.

queries.subject: Present workflow skill invocation totals with drill-through navigation to the workflow dashboard.
queries.objective: Expose observed workflow skill invocation totals with a link to inspect each workflow.
queries.acceptance: Each projected workflow coordinate, link, and invocation total traces to the grouped source; using a link to investigate does not establish that usage caused an outcome.

queries.subject: Count observed invocations for each skill and workflow.
queries.objective: Produce skill-by-workflow invocation totals for the downstream inventory.
queries.acceptance: Sum observed invocation counts by skill, organization, repository, and workflow; missing combinations are not evidence that a skill could not run.

queries.subject: List observed skills by workflow with drill-through navigation to the workflow dashboard.
queries.objective: Identify observed skill/workflow combinations and provide a workflow link for inspecting their runs.
queries.acceptance: Show the repository, workflow, skill, link, and observed invocation total from the grouped evidence; an absent row does not prove non-use, and a high count does not prove effectiveness.

queries.subject: Count observed run assignments for each experiment and workflow without inferring a completion target.
queries.objective: Expose assignment counts by experiment and workflow for investigating observed experiment coverage.
queries.acceptance: Count retained assignment rows in each experiment/workflow group, not distinct runs; do not invent a target, infer missing assignments from absent groups, or treat assignments as eval or grader outcomes.

queries.subject: Inspect every explicitly classified eval answer, including UNKNOWN.
queries.objective: Expose retained eval observations with their workflow, run evidence and observation time.
queries.acceptance: Keep recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN answers distinct; unknown or absent evidence must not imply success or failure, and historical answers are not current verdicts or validated operational outcomes.

queries.subject: Count recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN answers for each workflow-scoped eval.
queries.objective: Provide complete answer denominators before expanding each eval into three bars.
queries.acceptance: Keep canonical eval identities separate and count only explicitly classified observations. Select at most 33 complete eval groups, never truncate an answer group.

queries.subject: Compute the YES share of each eval's recorded answers.
queries.objective: Expose recorded YES proportions for comparing answer categories without inferring verified operational outcomes.
queries.acceptance: Emit one YES row per retained canonical eval group, including zero YES counts; answer-share is yes / answers across recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN observations. Do not count absent observations.

queries.subject: Compute the NO share of each eval's recorded answers.
queries.objective: Expose recorded NO proportions for comparing answer categories without treating historical answers as current verdicts.
queries.acceptance: Emit one NO row per retained canonical eval group, including zero NO counts; answer-share is no / answers across recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN observations. Do not count absent observations.

queries.subject: Compute the explicit UNKNOWN share of each eval's recorded answers.
queries.objective: Expose explicitly recorded UNKNOWN proportions without conflating absent observations with classified uncertainty.
queries.acceptance: Emit one UNKNOWN row per retained canonical eval group, including zero UNKNOWN counts; answer-share is unknown / answers across recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN observations. Missing observations are not UNKNOWN answers.

queries.subject: Compare YES, NO and UNKNOWN percentages within each eval.
queries.objective: Show three horizontal bars per eval that together account for all recorded answers.
queries.acceptance: Emit all three answer categories, including zero shares; percentages sum to 100 per canonical eval. Missing observations are not UNKNOWN answers. Preserve workflow and repository attribution.

queries.subject: Find each workflow-scoped grader's maximum retained value in the selected data.
queries.objective: Provide an observed normalization denominator without mixing grader identities or claiming a theoretical maximum.
queries.acceptance: Group by canonical grader identity, not display name; ignore missing values and preserve zero or negative maxima without substituting a denominator.

queries.subject: Normalize each grader observation by that grader's observed maximum.
queries.objective: Compare relative grader values over time while preserving native measurements and run provenance.
queries.acceptance: Compute value / max-grader-value without clamping or inverting lower-is-better measures; zero or missing denominators produce null, never a fabricated zero or infinity.

queries.subject: Plot timed grader observations with a defined value-to-observed-maximum ratio.
queries.objective: Show relative grader measurements at their recorded observation times.
queries.acceptance: Keep each eligible observation and its run link; omit missing ratios or observation times from the plot while retaining those records in the native-value ledger. Ratios are not eval answers or evidence of improvement.

queries.subject: Report grader measurements, units and explicit statuses without confusing them with binary eval answers.
queries.objective: Preserve numeric grader evidence and distinguish explicit per-observation pass and fail verdicts from unknown statuses.
queries.acceptance: Retain native grader values, units and statuses. Map only pass/passed to YES and fail/failed to NO in the auxiliary verdict field, leaving all other statuses unknown; never infer an eval answer, current success, causation or policy authority from a grader score.

queries.subject: Read metadata-only unified-session routing evidence.
queries.objective: Keep routing analytics independent of native logs and inferred run totals.
queries.acceptance: Only recognized session events contribute; event clocks remain absent when unrecorded.

queries.subject: Identify available session files and their earliest recorded clocks.
queries.objective: Keep rerun attempts from multiplying routing denominators.
queries.acceptance: Attempt order is only a tie-breaker after the recorded session clock.

queries.subject: Order duplicate run sessions by run time and attempt.
queries.objective: Keep the latest file for each repository/run identity.
queries.acceptance: Only one attempt contributes to routing facts.

queries.subject: Retain one authoritative session attempt per run.
queries.objective: Avoid mixing picks or accounting from reruns.
queries.acceptance: Duplicate attempts remain available in session coverage.

queries.subject: Read routing metadata from the latest session file per run.
queries.objective: Deduplicate rerun attempts before any metric.
queries.acceptance: Earlier attempts never add cost or change the selected pick.

queries.subject: Collect per-session source facts without interpreting absence as success.
queries.objective: Resolve routing states and coverage from runner and proxy evidence.
queries.acceptance: Agent-phase proxy selection wins over failure and harness status; untimed observations keep unknown time.

queries.subject: Order proxy selections within each session.
queries.objective: Use the last selection by normalized clock and file order.
queries.acceptance: Harness and advisory picks never override proxy selections.

queries.subject: Retain one authoritative proxy pick per run.
queries.objective: Avoid multiplying requests or run counts after re-selection.
queries.acceptance: One row per identified run uses the final proxy selection.

queries.subject: Resolve routing state, pick and label cells from unified sessions.
queries.objective: Distinguish selected, failed, harness-only, configured, inferred and unknown evidence.
queries.acceptance: Proxy evidence wins; configuration conflicts are visible; missing picks and time remain unknown.

queries.subject: Apply one run-level scope before every routing metric and event join.
queries.objective: Filter complete sessions, never fragments of their evidence.
queries.acceptance: Unknown run time is excluded from a bounded range; blank filters retain all known values.

queries.subject: Retain identified runs matching every selected routing filter.
queries.objective: Use the same population for adoption, accounting and outcomes.
queries.acceptance: A time bound excludes untimed runs and does not remove individual events from retained sessions.

queries.subject: Retain all evidence belonging to scoped identified runs.
queries.objective: Filter event metrics by the resolved run rather than by individual event clocks.
queries.acceptance: State, pick and accounting are computed before the scope is applied.

queries.subject: Choose one nonoverlapping accounting source per run and phase.
queries.objective: Prefer proxy token usage over usage reports.
queries.acceptance: Snapshot totals and cumulative totalAic never enter additive cost.

queries.subject: Read nonoverlapping per-response accounting records.
queries.objective: Expose recorded credits and token classes without repricing unknown usage.
queries.acceptance: Each phase uses proxy accounting when present and usage.report otherwise; absent AIC is counted.

queries.subject: Select the authoritative accounting source for each phase.
queries.objective: Exclude overlapping usage reports and snapshots.
queries.acceptance: Every accounting row contributes at most once.

queries.subject: Keep per-request routing decisions separate from accounting.
queries.objective: Join routed outcomes by run, phase and request ID.
queries.acceptance: Rejected requests establish local zero cost; other unmatched requests retain unknown cost.

queries.subject: Retain the latest record for each request identity.
queries.objective: Avoid duplicate request joins and overlapping totals.
queries.acceptance: Requests without IDs remain independent, not falsely correlated.

queries.subject: Read engine-reported sub-agent request ownership.
queries.objective: Use exact request-ID ownership before falling back to unsplit traffic.
queries.acceptance: Only request identities can assign exact ownership; advisory outcomes never assign credits.

queries.subject: Retain one sub-agent observation per request identity.
queries.objective: Keep exact ownership joins unique.
queries.acceptance: Missing identities do not match unrelated requests.

queries.subject: Attribute each accounting record to exactly one traffic bucket.
queries.objective: Keep detection, evals, classifier, exact sub-agent, main, unsplit and unattributed credits distinct.
queries.acceptance: Detection and evals use phase, missing purpose is never agent by default, and snapshot credits are excluded.

queries.subject: Find accounting records without exact sub-agent ownership.
queries.objective: Correlate only fully recorded token quartets in file order.
queries.acceptance: Missing token classes never match by model alone.

queries.subject: Order unmatched accounting within model and token quartet.
queries.objective: Match each engine-reported request at most once.
queries.acceptance: Classifier, incomplete and already-exact requests are excluded.

queries.subject: Exclude engine requests already matched by proxy request ID.
queries.objective: Prevent exact and correlated ownership from claiming the same request.
queries.acceptance: Only engine requests with a complete quartet and a definition name can correlate.

queries.subject: Order unmatched engine requests within each model/token quartet.
queries.objective: Produce deterministic one-to-one correlated ownership.
queries.acceptance: Correlation is labelled separately from exact evidence.

queries.subject: Join proxy usage with unmatched engine requests by model, quartet and occurrence.
queries.objective: Use the spec's correlated sub-agent attribution without duplicating credits.
queries.acceptance: Each engine request and accounting record participates at most once.

queries.subject: Assign every accounting record to exactly one exclusive bucket.
queries.objective: Keep exact and correlated sub-agent ownership distinct.
queries.acceptance: Phase wins over purpose; missing ownership remains unsplit or unattributed.

queries.subject: Inspect per-request deviations and outcomes against proxy picks.
queries.objective: Keep requests without accounting visible and never invent a deviation cause.
queries.acceptance: Unmatched requests have unknown cost; each request retains its own requested and selected model.

queries.subject: Count failed requests lacking accounting per run.
queries.objective: Recognize only unambiguous AWF-local effort failures.
queries.acceptance: A run-level effort failure cannot assign zero to multiple failed requests.

queries.subject: Resolve explicit local zero costs and preserve all other unknown request costs.
queries.objective: Avoid partial-cost comparisons based on missing accounting.
queries.acceptance: Only guard rejection or an unambiguous local effort failure establishes zero AIC.

queries.subject: Sum nonoverlapping accounting per run and phase.
queries.objective: Establish complete costs only with known response values.
queries.acceptance: Unknown response costs remain counted.

queries.subject: Count requests whose cost remains unknown.
queries.objective: Exclude incomplete runs from distribution comparisons.
queries.acceptance: Unmatched nonlocal requests cannot be treated as free.

queries.subject: Evaluate accounting completeness using collected source receipts and request joins.
queries.objective: Exclude partial costs from medians and comparisons.
queries.acceptance: A complete phase has its selected accounting source, no missing AIC and no unaccounted nonlocal requests.

queries.subject: Select complete or explicitly partial agent-phase costs.
queries.objective: Keep detection and evals out of agent-phase comparisons.
queries.acceptance: Classifier remains part of agent-phase cost.

queries.subject: Retain detection-phase cost completeness separately.
queries.objective: Do not count detection as classifier or agent traffic.
queries.acceptance: Missing detection evidence remains unknown, not zero.

queries.subject: Attach accounting completeness to identified routing runs.
queries.objective: Provide comparable costs only for complete runs.
queries.acceptance: An absent cost stays unknown and never inherits aggregate run AIC.

queries.subject: Keep the selected Run's compact routing and baseline evidence visible.
queries.objective: Preserve the comparison when shorter-lived Audit detail expires.
queries.acceptance: Retained aggregate costs and baseline evidence survive Audit expiry; absent phase details stay unknown.

queries.subject: Summarize complete agent-phase costs by UTC ISO week and routing state.
queries.objective: Expose trends without including partial costs.
queries.acceptance: Untimed runs cannot enter time buckets.

queries.subject: Gate weekly medians by complete sample size.
queries.objective: Keep sparse weeks from implying meaningful cost trends.
queries.acceptance: Weeks below the configurable minimum display insufficient data.

queries.subject: Read runner-written configured-model resolutions for scoped routing runs.
queries.objective: Explain what each workflow role's configured model resolved to before the engine launched.
queries.acceptance: Only model.resolution facts from latest scoped attempts contribute; missing or unsafe values and failed null resolutions remain unknown.

queries.subject: Count routed runs and their selection, failure, adherence, outcome and cost evidence per repository and workflow.
queries.objective: Answer whether routing is on and working from one row per routed workflow.
queries.acceptance: Only selected, selection_failed, harness_reported and configured_unrecorded runs contribute; runs without evidence stay out of each denominator.

queries.subject: Show routing health shares per repository and workflow.
queries.objective: Tell whether routing is on and working from selection, failure or fallback, pick adherence, known outcomes and complete cost.
queries.acceptance: A zero denominator or no complete cost is unknown, never zero; unknown job outcomes are excluded from the success rate.

queries.subject: Count proxy-selected runs by UTC ISO week and picked model.
queries.objective: Show what the router chooses over time.
queries.acceptance: Only selected runs with a known pick model and a recorded run clock contribute; an unrecorded effort does not exclude a run.

queries.subject: Weekly paired complete main-request costs by baseline model.
queries.objective: Compare routing cost trends with each named baseline using identical main-request populations.
queries.acceptance: Only timed runs with complete positive baseline estimates and matching known main-request costs contribute to both medians.

queries.subject: Paired main-request samples that meet the chosen evidence floor.
queries.objective: Avoid changing routing policy based on insufficient paired evidence.
queries.acceptance: Observed and estimated series share the same complete-run count and configurable minimum sample.

queries.subject: Observed main-request AIC for the same eligible runs as each baseline.
queries.objective: Identify weeks when routed main-request costs exceed the matching baseline estimate.
queries.acceptance: Observed medians exclude classifier and sub-agent costs and remain unknown below the paired sample floor.

queries.subject: Explicitly estimated baseline AIC for paired main-agent requests.
queries.objective: Show the named counterfactual against which owners can assess routing goal or mode.
queries.acceptance: The series is labelled estimated, separates baseline models and uses exactly the observed series' eligible runs.

queries.subject: Compare the same main-agent requests to an explicitly estimated baseline.
queries.objective: Change routing goal or mode when paired observed cost exceeds the named baseline.
queries.acceptance: Keep agent-phase accounting separate, baseline models distinct and sparse weeks as gaps.

queries.subject: Runs whose routing failure codes require investigation.
queries.objective: Investigate routing configuration or execution failures before changing rollout.
queries.acceptance: Emit one row per run with recorded routing failure identifiers, excluding upstream errors handled by their own kind.

queries.subject: Runs whose requests deviated from the routing pick.
queries.objective: Investigate why requests did not follow the selected model or effort.
queries.acceptance: Emit one row per run with distinct recorded deviation causes, without inferring causes from model names.

queries.subject: Runs whose configured models could not be resolved.
queries.objective: Correct model aliases or restore catalogue availability for failed resolutions.
queries.acceptance: Emit one row per run with recorded resolution failure causes, not absence of resolution evidence.

queries.subject: Provider-rejected requests with distinct upstream error codes.
queries.objective: Correct model or effort settings rejected by the provider.
queries.acceptance: Emit one upstream-error row per run with distinct safe codes or unknown, never a duplicate generic routing failure.

queries.subject: Runs whose full eligible pool contains choices the router cannot rank.
queries.objective: Review allowed models when the router cannot rank the complete eligible pool.
queries.acceptance: Emit one row only when both pool counters are known and overlap is below eligibility, displaying the observed ratio.

queries.subject: List routing failures, deviations and resolution failures with one row per run and kind.
queries.objective: Show what needs attention and link each problem to its run page.
queries.acceptance: Time is the run's recorded observation time and stays unknown without a run clock; untimed rows sort after timed rows.

queries.subject: Model daily run volume and 30-day retained detail from user-supplied scenario inputs.
queries.objective: Compare hypothetical workload choices without treating results as observed activity.
queries.acceptance: Each simulated day uses the selected inputs; skipped runs retain summaries and detailed records have a 30-day lifetime.
queries.description: Each simulated day includes all accumulated run summaries; tools and issues belong only to non-skipped runs and expire after 30 days.

queries.subject: Estimate retained run-summary table size at 512 bytes per run.
queries.objective: Show modeled accumulation of run summaries.
queries.acceptance: Summary size includes every simulated run at 512 bytes and is not presented as measured storage.

queries.subject: Estimate retained tool table size at 256 bytes per tool on non-skipped runs.
queries.objective: Show modeled tool-record growth under the selected workload.
queries.acceptance: Tool size uses only non-skipped simulated runs and 256 bytes per tool over the retained period.

queries.subject: Estimate retained issue table size at 512 bytes per issue on non-skipped runs.
queries.objective: Show modeled issue-record growth under the selected workload.
queries.acceptance: Issue size uses only non-skipped simulated runs and 512 bytes per issue over the retained period.

queries.subject: Show modeled run-summary, tool, and issue table bytes after 30 days.
queries.objective: Compare hypothetical database table sizes at the end of the retention horizon.
queries.acceptance: The model presents separate summary, tool, and issue estimates after 30 simulated days, never observed storage.
queries.description: Run summaries accumulate; detailed records have a 30-day TTL.

queries.subject: Sum the modeled table sizes after 30 days.
queries.objective: Show the final estimated size of the modeled database tables.
queries.acceptance: The final value is the sum of the three modeled table sizes after 30 days.

queries.subject: List modeled table sizes and their final total after 30 days.
queries.objective: Present the 30-day estimate in a compact table.
queries.acceptance: Three modeled table sizes and their summed final value are shown without a growth chart.

queries.subject: Summarize successful, failed, and active runs with rollout-mode counts.
queries.objective: Expose observed success, failure, and active run counts, including active live and review modes, for the selected horizon.
queries.acceptance: Each count follows its declared conclusion, status, and rollout-mode filters; run success is not treated as a verified outcome, and incomplete or stale evidence is identified.

queries.subject: Count distinct target repositories with successful worker dispatch runs in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: Measure observed reach among registered repositories with successful dispatched worker runs.
queries.acceptance: Distinct delivered-repositories is limited to registered targets and successful workflow_dispatch worker runs in the selected horizon; it does not establish accepted delivery or authorized coverage.

queries.subject: Count all observed grader results.
queries.objective: Identify whether any grader observations are available to the Overview status presentation.
queries.acceptance: The value-gains field counts observed grader records only; inspect each result's native measure, unit, direction, maturity, and uncertainty before claiming an outcome or improvement.

queries.subject: Count retained issue and pull request safe-output records for Overview.
queries.objective: Restore the issue and pull request counter with a link to its evidence inventory.
queries.acceptance: The count includes retained canonical issue and pull request records, not inferred outcomes; unavailable evidence remains unavailable.

queries.subject: Present the retained issue and pull request count for Overview.
queries.objective: Provide a presentation-ready count and accessible evidence description.
queries.acceptance: The value matches overview-issue-summary and describes retained safe outputs, not accepted outcomes.

queries.subject: Present the observed grader-result count as the legacy Value gains counter.
queries.objective: Restore the Value gains counter while making its observation-count semantics explicit.
queries.acceptance: The count matches overview-value-summary, including zero; grader presence is not proof of improvement and unavailable evidence is not zero.

queries.subject: Prepare the compact run summary for declarative factory status classification.
queries.objective: Carry successful-runs, failed-runs, and active-runs into the status join without changing their meaning.
queries.acceptance: The projected counts retain the selected horizon and match overview-run-summary; the join key is only a presentation key, not additional evidence.

queries.subject: Prepare the compact value summary for declarative factory status classification.
queries.objective: Carry the grader-observation count into the optional status join.
queries.acceptance: The projected value-gains count matches overview-value-summary; a zero count does not establish complete grader coverage, and a nonzero count is not proof of gain.

queries.subject: Classify the factory heading from compact run and optional value evidence.
queries.objective: Provide a bounded Overview heading based on observed run counts and optional grader-record presence.
queries.acceptance: The heading matches the declared run-count and optional grader-presence branches; grader presence is not verified value, and the heading does not authorize any policy change.

queries.subject: Count canonical repository identities registered in the resolved control-plane scope.
queries.objective: Provide the registered-repository denominator for observed worker reach.
queries.acceptance: The count reflects canonical repository records in the resolved scope; it is not evidence of live enrollment, successful execution, or full inventory completeness.

queries.subject: Prepare successful delivery totals for the repository coverage summary.
queries.objective: Carry the distinct delivered-repositories count into the coverage join.
queries.acceptance: The projected count equals overview-delivery-summary for the selected horizon; the join key adds no repository observations.

queries.subject: Prepare registered repository totals for the repository coverage summary.
queries.objective: Carry the registered-repositories count into the coverage denominator join.
queries.acceptance: The projected count equals overview-registered-repository-summary for the resolved scope; missing inventory is not treated as zero eligible targets.

queries.subject: Compare all workflow runs by weekday, layering this week over last week.
queries.objective: Show the observed weekday pattern across both calendar weeks, regardless of status or conclusion.
queries.acceptance: Verify weekday order, counts including unsuccessful and in-flight runs, and reached-day flags. Missing rhythm is unavailable, not zero activity; do not attribute changes to workflow improvements.

queries.subject: Aggregate reached and total repositories across the resolved organization scope.
queries.objective: Pair observed reached-repositories and registered-repositories-total for a comparable coverage denominator.
queries.acceptance: Both totals come from their named input queries and share the resolved scope; verify the left-joined inventory source independently before interpreting a zero total, since a missing join can aggregate to zero.

queries.subject: Measure registered repository reach from successful worker execution.
queries.objective: Present observed successful-worker repository reach as a ratio alongside numerator and denominator.
queries.acceptance: repository-coverage is reached-repositories divided by registered-repositories-total when available; preserve the counts and undefined denominator, and do not call reach successful outcomes.

queries.subject: Assess current runtime failures for every workflow across CAO and targeted repositories.
queries.objective: Compute the latest consecutive completed-run failure streak for each repository-scoped workflow without requiring campaign membership.
queries.acceptance: Group by organization, repository, and workflow; in-flight retries do not clear failures, and later non-failing completed runs reset the streak within the selected horizon.

queries.subject: Count all registered workflows and those without current observed runtime failures.
queries.objective: Provide Factory health numerator and denominator across CAO and targeted repositories, including standalone and campaign workflows.
queries.acceptance: Each repository-scoped workflow counts once regardless of campaign or role; no retained failure is not proof of successful execution, missing inventory remains unavailable, and missing run evidence marks the result incomplete.

queries.subject: Prepare all-workflow health counts for Overview presentation.
queries.objective: Carry Factory health counts into the header and station presentation.
queries.acceptance: Both counts match overview-workflow-health-summary and preserve missing evidence metadata.

queries.subject: Produce presentation-ready Factory health values for the Overview header and floor.
queries.objective: Display the ratio of workflows without current observed runtime failures to all registered workflows with both underlying counts.
queries.acceptance: The percentage and detail agree with healthy-workflows and workflows; a missing or zero denominator remains unavailable, and the ratio is not proof of impact.

queries.subject: Prepare the factory status heading for the declarative Overview header.
queries.objective: Carry the factory heading into the Overview header join unchanged.
queries.acceptance: The heading matches overview-factory-status; the presentation key does not imply additional evidence or a policy recommendation.

queries.subject: Resolve the Overview heading from declarative status and factory-health evidence.
queries.objective: Display the configured heading corresponding to observed run status and factory health.
queries.acceptance: The selected heading follows the declared presentation branches; numeric branch boundaries are UI classification only, not operational targets or rollout thresholds.

queries.subject: Prepare active run state for Overview station presentation.
queries.objective: Expose whether at least one queued or in-progress run was observed for station display.
queries.acceptance: active reflects overview-run-summary's active-runs count; no observed active run does not prove the fleet is idle when the snapshot is incomplete.

queries.subject: Provide the presentation-ready Factory health station for Overview.
queries.objective: Show the all-workflow runtime health ratio, supporting counts, and observed run motion together.
queries.acceptance: Station value, display, detail, description, and active flag match their input queries; neither absence of failures nor run motion is verified workflow effectiveness.

queries.subject: Prepare repository coverage for the presentation-ready Overview station.
queries.objective: Format repository reach with its reached and registered counts for the station.
queries.acceptance: The percentage and detail preserve overview-repository-coverage's numerator and denominator; unavailable coverage remains unavailable, not zero or complete reach.

queries.subject: Provide the presentation-ready repository coverage station for Overview.
queries.objective: Show observed registered-repository worker reach and run motion in one station.
queries.acceptance: Value and formatted evidence match the coverage presentation input, and active matches run motion; neither changes policy or establishes accepted outcomes.

queries.subject: Present observed AI Credit cost grouped by repository.
queries.objective: Locate repositories with higher observed AI Credit totals for evidence-led investigation.
queries.acceptance: Each repository coordinate and native aic total agrees with repository-aic-totals; confirm the selected horizon and underlying runs before attributing cost or proposing a change.

queries.subject: Present observed AI Credit cost grouped by repository-owned workflow.
queries.objective: Locate repository workflows with higher observed AI Credit totals and open their workflow evidence.
queries.acceptance: Workflow identity, link, and native aic total match workflow-aic-totals in descending order; cost alone does not establish waste, quality, or value.

queries.subject: Present the average observed AI Credit cost of a single run for each repository-owned workflow.
queries.objective: Compare observed AI Credit per run across repository workflows with each observed-runs denominator.
queries.acceptance: Include only workflows with positive-AIC run attempts, and use only those attempts in cost averages; observed-runs still counts all retained attempts.
queries.description: Observed AI Credit totals divided by positive-AIC run attempts for each declared workflow.

queries.subject: Select retained runs with failure, startup-failure, stale, or timed-out conclusions for the failed-run ledger and streak inputs.
queries.objective: Provide one consistent failure-conclusion evidence set to downstream Overview queries.
queries.acceptance: Each selected run has one of the four declared conclusions within the selected horizon; other conclusions remain outside this set, and missing run coverage is not interpreted as no failures.

queries.subject: List failed workflow runs that need operator attention.
queries.objective: Give operators the most recent observed failed runs to inspect in GitHub.
queries.acceptance: Unprojected run rows retain available conclusion, started-at, and run evidence fields in descending started-at order; inspect source logs and missing links before attributing a cause or declaring resolution.

queries.subject: Identify failed runs in the selected snapshot horizon so subsequent streak logic can use the same declarative failure definition.
queries.objective: Project distinct failure-run counts by organization, repository, workflow, and run for streak joins.
queries.acceptance: Each grouped run identity has a failing-runs count derived from failure-run-base in the selected horizon; this stage does not assert a consecutive streak or require action.

queries.subject: Identify only workflows that have at least one failed run in the selected snapshot horizon before computing streaks.
queries.objective: Provide workflow identities with observed failed runs for the streak computation.
queries.acceptance: Each organization/repository/workflow group has a distinct failing-runs count from overview-failing-runs; the count covers observed failures, not the latest consecutive streak.

queries.subject: Group each workflow's latest consecutive failing run sequence in the selected snapshot horizon, resetting the group after any successful run.
queries.objective: Project the latest observed consecutive failure-count per workflow for downstream blocked-work matching.
queries.acceptance: failure-count follows run ordering and the declared latest-failure-streak reducer, with non-failing runs breaking the streak; missing earlier runs or incomplete snapshots limit the observed sequence.

queries.subject: Attach selected-horizon failure counts to each workflow's latest canonical work item.
queries.objective: Pair blocked work items with observed workflow failure streaks and retained run evidence before attention filtering.
queries.acceptance: Candidates are filtered to blocked items with a matching organization/repository/workflow streak; is-repeated reflects failure-count greater than one, while selected evidence-link and run-link can be absent or refer to the work item rather than the latest failed run.

queries.acceptance: Every row inherits a blocked item with is-repeated true and projects evidence-link and run-link when available; verify run order, links, and current state before treating the failure as still unresolved.

queries.acceptance: Rows are filtered to lifecycle-state review and project the work-item ID as attention-signal-id, plus reason, evidence-link, and run-link where present; reviewer disposition must be checked at source.

queries.objective: Prioritize observed blocked repeated-failure work and review-state outputs for investigation.
queries.acceptance: Rows come only from the repeated-failure or review inputs and retain their source reasons, links, and ordering; confirm fresh source status before acting, and do not equate a missing row with resolved work.

queries.subject: Project the selected domain header and one retained run link.
queries.objective: Identify the selected domain and open a retained run before investigating its traffic evidence.
queries.acceptance: The route header preserves the selected domain and a run link from its retained observations; missing observations or links remain unavailable, and a header does not establish access policy or traffic completeness.

queries.subject: Retained run-linked observations for the selected domain.
queries.objective: Find related runs without returning the unscoped domain collection alongside the paginated view.
queries.acceptance: Preserve every domain observation field, exact route scope, filtering, ordering, total count, provenance and related-run links; only the bounded view payload crosses the worker boundary.

queries.subject: Project the selected MCP tool header and one retained run link.
queries.objective: Identify the selected MCP tool and open a retained run before investigating its call evidence.
queries.acceptance: The route header preserves the selected MCP tool label and a run link from its retained calls; absent calls or links remain unavailable and do not imply zero usage or tool effectiveness.

queries.subject: Project the selected audit summary header and one retained run link.
queries.objective: Identify the selected audit summary and open a retained run before investigating its observations.
queries.acceptance: The route header preserves the selected event summary and a run link from its retained audit observations; absent evidence remains unavailable and neither the header nor its absence establishes incident severity or a clean audit.

queries.subject: Summarize one domain entity for its dedicated Insights view.
queries.objective: Identify domain decisions with request volume worth investigating before considering any egress change.
queries.acceptance: For the selected domain, request totals match the retained domain observations grouped by decision; missing data or blocked traffic does not establish a need for access, which requires underlying request and policy review.

queries.subject: Summarize one tool entity for its dedicated Insights view.
queries.objective: Select a tool and status combination whose recorded call volume merits investigation.
queries.acceptance: For the selected tool, observation counts match retained MCP call observations grouped by server, tool, and status; missing calls are not zero usage and status counts do not establish effectiveness or cause.

queries.subject: Summarize one audit event entity for its dedicated Insights view.
queries.objective: Select an audit summary and status requiring closer review of underlying observations.
queries.acceptance: For the selected summary, counts agree with retained audit observation IDs grouped by event status; repeated observations are not silently treated as distinct incidents, and absence does not prove no findings.
